EC1: 1. prior randomization to either STAR or usual care study arms;
EC2: 2. [NOT] not a North Carolina resident [OR] or residence >2.5-hour drive time from treating hospital;
EC3: 3. the only antibiotic associated with patient is administered in the operating room as this likely represents pre-operative infection [AND] prophylaxis and [NOT] not presumed infection;
EC4: 4. patients transferred from other acute care hospitals;
EC5: 5. patients with a change in code status (i.e., do not resuscitate, [OR] do not intubate) within 24 hours after admission due to the general assumption of increased risk of exposure to less aggressive treatment;
EC6: 6. patients with infection [NOT] ruled out during the index hospitalization.
